mode_1_classical_deterministic.best_use_case: Standard unprinted plain fabrics with uniform illumination where spatial calibration scale (px/cm) is known and zero GPU compute is required.
mode_1_classical_deterministic.operational_boundary: Fails or requires review on dense satin/twill weaves with long yarn floats (due to harmonic ambiguity) and low-contrast optical images.

mode_2_learned_regression.best_use_case: Complex weave classification and rapid approximate density estimation on standardized 1cm microscope fields without manual peak tuning.
mode_2_learned_regression.operational_boundary: Does not generalize across differing optical magnifications or camera sensor geometries unless retrained or normalized.

mode_3_hybrid_analysis.best_use_case: Challenging real-world swatches with surface color, heather yarn patterns, or uneven illumination where the neural network isolates physical yarn bodies and deterministic geometry guarantees metric accuracy.
mode_3_hybrid_analysis.operational_boundary: Requires GPU or optimized ONNX runtime to meet sub-50ms latency targets.
